heading: Headquarters, principal office, and meetings
lead: The corporation shall maintain its principal office and national headquarters in a place in the United States decided by the corporation. The corporation may hold its annual and special meetings in the places decided by the corporation.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 22050836:371 (last sentence).Sept. 21, 1950, ch. 975, title I, § 101 (last sentence), formerly § 1 (last sentence), 64 Stat. 899; Nov. 8, 1978, Pub. L. 95–606, § 1(a)(3), 92 Stat. 3045. The word “decided” is substituted for “as is determined” and for “shall determine” for consistency in the revised title.
